## Relevant Posts

```{=html}
<div class="card-grid more-insights" data-more-insights>
  <article class="content-card">
    <h3>Browse All Insights</h3>
    <p>See published notes by category, including creator analytics, reporting systems, data collection, and mixed-methods analysis.</p>
    <p><a href="../insights.html">Back to Insights</a></p>
  </article>
</div>

<script>
(() => {
  const posts = [
    {
      title: "Inspiration for Sun Data Analytics",
      href: "01_data_driven_analytics.html",
      date: "2026-06-02",
      categories: ["Content Creation", "Reporting Systems", "Creator Analytics"],
      summary: "How creator analytics helped turn scattered platform data into calmer, evidence-informed decisions."
    },
    {
      title: "Utilizing LLMs for Qualitative Analysis",
      href: "02_leveraging_LLMs_for_Qual.html",
      date: "2026-06-02",
      categories: ["Method Notes", "Mixed-Methods Analysis", "Data Collection"],
      summary: "How transcripts, chat logs, and other text-heavy materials can be organized for qualitative analysis at a larger scale."
    },
    {
      title: "Using the Creator Performance Report",
      href: "03_using_creator_performance_report.html",
      date: "2026-06-02",
      categories: ["Creator Performance Report", "Creator Analytics", "Reporting Systems"],
      summary: "A short companion guide for understanding what the Creator Performance Report is for and how to use it."
    },
    {
      title: "Numbers Go Brr: Terms and Definitions",
      href: "04_Terms_to_Remember.html",
      date: "2026-06-02",
      categories: ["Creator Performance Report", "Method Notes", "Reporting Systems"],
      summary: "A glossary of common report terms, metrics, and interpretation notes used across creator performance reports."
    },
    {
      title: "How Stream Title Classification Works",
      href: "06_classification_definitions.html",
      date: "2026-06-03",
      categories: ["Creator Performance Report", "Creator Analytics", "Classification", "Methods"],
      summary: "A public-facing guide to how stream titles are grouped into broad interpretive categories for reporting."
    },
    {
      title: "How to Read Creator Report Charts",
      href: "07_reading_creator_report_charts.html",
      date: "2026-06-02",
      categories: ["Creator Performance Report", "Creator Analytics", "Reporting Systems", "Methods"],
      summary: "A chart-by-chart guide for interpreting content type comparisons, revenue trends, boxplots, audience composition, timing, topics, and tags."
    }
  ];

  const container = document.querySelector("[data-more-insights]");
  if (!container) return;

  const currentPath = window.location.pathname.split("/").pop();
  const currentPost = posts.find((post) => post.href === currentPath);
  const reportGuideOrder = [
    "03_using_creator_performance_report.html",
    "07_reading_creator_report_charts.html",
    "04_Terms_to_Remember.html",
    "06_classification_definitions.html"
  ];

  const isCreatorPerformanceReport = currentPost?.categories.includes("Creator Performance Report");
  const candidatePosts = isCreatorPerformanceReport
    ? posts
        .filter((post) => post.categories.includes("Creator Performance Report"))
        .sort((a, b) => reportGuideOrder.indexOf(a.href) - reportGuideOrder.indexOf(b.href))
    : posts;

  const relevantPosts = candidatePosts
    .filter((post) => post.href !== currentPath)
    .slice(0, 3);

  const cards = relevantPosts.length
    ? relevantPosts.map((post) => `
        <article class="content-card">
          <h3>${post.title}</h3>
          <p>${post.summary}</p>
          <p><a href="${post.href}">Read insight</a></p>
        </article>
      `)
    : [`
        <article class="content-card">
          <h3>More Insights Coming Soon</h3>
          <p>Future insight pages will appear here as they are published.</p>
        </article>
      `];

  cards.push(`
    <article class="content-card">
      <h3>Browse All Insights</h3>
      <p>See published notes by category, including creator analytics, reporting systems, data collection, and mixed-methods analysis.</p>
      <p><a href="../insights.html">Back to Insights</a></p>
    </article>
  `);

  container.innerHTML = cards.join("");
})();
</script>
```
